data.narrative:
Gauss Fusion is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by Milena Roveda that has raised €9M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a frontier-tech sector comprising 3 public comparables (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Fuse Energy, Oklo, X-Energy, Nano Nuclear Energy, and General Matter.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The nuclear energy sector contains only 4 same-sector peers in total, with insufficient overlap in stage, timing, and valuation tier to establish a statistically reliable peer set of three or more companies. Applying an all-sector median would introduce material bias given the heterogeneity of nuclear subsectors and development stages represented. The public comparables operate at substantially different scales and technology maturity than Gauss Fusion, limiting direct multiple transfer.

Given these constraints, a valuation range cannot be triangulated from the available data. Establishing a defensible valuation would require either: (i) direct financial metric analysis of Gauss Fusion (revenue, burn rate, capital efficiency), (ii) scenario-based DCF modeling incorporating technology-specific risk factors, or (iii) expansion of the comparable universe to adjacent energy subsectors with equivalent risk and stage characteristics. The primary uncertainty is the absence of narrow peer precedents; this reflects genuine scarcity of comparable Series A nuclear ventures rather than a data collection limitation. Future rounds may benefit from increased public market activity in this sector.
